_comment: Retell AI agent configuration. Upload via Retell dashboard or API.
begin_message: Thank you for calling {{CLINIC_NAME}}, this is Sophie! How can I help you today?
reminder_message: I'm still here — just pulling that up for you. One moment...

post_call_analysis_data.name: call_outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: What was the final outcome of this call?

post_call_analysis_data.name: patient_type
post_call_analysis_data.description: Was this a new or returning patient?

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_requested
post_call_analysis_data.description: What service did the patient call about?

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_date
post_call_analysis_data.description: Date of the appointment if booked (YYYY-MM-DD)

post_call_analysis_data.name: unhandled_request
post_call_analysis_data.description: Was there anything the agent could not handle? Describe it.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Check available appointment slots for a given date/time range and service type. Call this BEFORE confirming any appointment time with the patient.

requested_date.description: The date the patient wants, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use 'today' or 'tomorrow' if patient says that.

requested_time.description: The time the patient wants, in HH:MM 24h format. Use null if patient has no preference.

service_id.description: The service identifier from the services list (e.g. 'cleaning', 'emergency', 'whitening')

doctor_id.description: Specific doctor ID if patient requested one. Use null for any available doctor.

same_day_only.description: Set to true if this is an emergency requiring same-day availability.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a confirmed appointment. Only call this AFTER the patient has verbally confirmed ALL details (name, phone, date, time, service).

doctor_id.description: Specific doctor or null for any

notes.description: Any special notes from the call

function.name: get_appointment
function.description: Look up an existing appointment by patient name and/or phone number.

approximate_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD if they remember roughly when

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date/time.

patient_confirmed.description: Did the patient explicitly confirm cancellation?

function.name: transfer_to_staff
function.description: Transfer the call to a human staff member. Use for emergencies, complaints, human requests, billing questions, or anything the agent cannot handle.

summary.description: Brief summary of the call so staff knows what to expect

function.name: log_callback_request
function.description: Log a callback request for after-hours callers or when staff transfer is unavailable.
